from.place: its statement: the scalar action of global sections on Hom of sheaves of modules

title: Hom of sheaves of modules as a module over global sections
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$ and $\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ its ring of global sections (the families $(s_V)_{V\in\mathcal C}$, $s_V\in\mathcal O(V)$, compatible with all restriction maps; when $\mathcal C$ has a final object $T$ it is $\mathcal O(T)$). For sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ the abelian group $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ of morphisms of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules is a $\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$-module by $(s\varphi)_V(x)=s_V\,\varphi_V(x)$ for $x\in\mathcal F(V)$; equivalently $s\varphi=\varphi\circ(s\cdot)=(s\cdot)\circ\varphi$, where $s\cdot$ is multiplication by $s$ on $\mathcal F$, resp. $\mathcal G$ (these agree, and $s\varphi$ is again $\mathcal O$-linear, because $\mathcal O$ is commutative). Composition of morphisms is $\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$-bilinear.
